# tidyq 1.0 Release Notes

We're thrilled to announce tidyq 1.0, our biggest release yet!

## New Features
- Blazing fast distributed processing with Redis and RabbitMQ backends
- Cloud-native autoscaling workers
- A brand new web dashboard
- Async/await support everywhere

## Improvements
- Up to 10x performance gains
- Better error messages

Upgrade today with pip install --upgrade tidyq!
with_context:
# tidyq 1.0

tidyq is a task queue for apps that run on one machine: one SQLite file, no broker to run.

## What 1.0 means

- A stable public API. From here on, breaking changes come only in major versions, each with a migration note.
- Retry policies with backoff.
- Windows support.
- A documentation site.

## Unchanged on purpose

- The core still has no dependencies outside the standard library; integrations stay extras.
- Every public function is typed and documented.

## Upgrading from 0.x

Migration note: to write. I do not have the list of API changes since 0.x, so I left it empty rather than guess. Paste the changelog or the diff and I will fill it in.

Release date: not set yet (the target is the end of November).
